persona_and_vibe: Premium Enterprise-SaaS / Command Center. Precision, Authority, Futuristic but Grounded. 'Swiss Brutalist' mixed with 'Old Money Tech'. Data-dense, analytical, and highly structured. Absolutely NO generic 'AI-slop' purple gradients.

headings.usage: Use for all main dashboard titles, module names, and hero numbers. Use lighter weights for large sizes.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, paragraphs, forms, and general UI text.

mono.usage: Use for KPI numbers, financial data, code snippets, or 'agent status' logs.

rules: 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists ONLY to guide action or indicate status.
Never use pure black #000000. Base background is #050505.
Use 'Electric Blaze' (#FF3B30) as the primary kinetic trigger (buttons, active states).
Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have subtle borders on right and bottom.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px to 4px). No pill shapes for standard cards, keeping it sharp and technical.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Remove all soft drop shadows. Rely entirely on 1px borders (border-border) for definition. Use a stark 1px solid stroke or 2px inner glow for highlights.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to prevent 'digital flatness'.

grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Collapsible left navigation panel. Fixed width (e.g., w-64). Darker than main content area (#050505). Active states indicated by a sharp 2px left border in accent_primary.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col base. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.cards: Cardless aesthetic. Sections are defined by exposed grid borders, not floating floating containers.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense internal spacing for data components (p-3, p-4), but generous spacing between major layout regions (p-8, p-12). Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

components.general: Use Shadcn components but heavily strip default Vercel-like styling. Make them flat, sharp-edged, and bordered.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white hover:bg-[#D63026]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-900.
components.tables: Dense rows. text-sm body. Use Monospace for numbers. border-b border-zinc-800 for row dividers.
components.charts: Recharts. Use monochrome lines (zinc-300) with a single vibrant color (like #FF3B30) for the primary data series. Remove background grid lines or make them extremely subtle (zinc-900). No gradient fills under lines.
components.forms: Inputs have border-zinc-800, bg-transparent. On focus: ring-0 border-[#FF3B30].
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a dense, highly legible, technical look.

motion.philosophy: Minimalist, mechanical, and instantaneous. Micro-interactions for feedback, not decoration.
motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly change text color and border color.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties. transition-colors duration-200 ease-out.
motion.data_loading: Use Skeleton loaders (Shadcn) matched exactly to the component dimensions. Staggered fade-ins for list items.

accessibility.contrast: Normal text min 4.5:1. Use Text Shadow over any images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-strategy').

images.strategy: Minimal use of images. Data is the hero. Use abstract visualizations or sharp portraits when necessary.
images.overlays: If an image is used as a background, max overlay opacity bg-black/50.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a data-dense Autonomous Marketing Command Center. Adhere strictly to the Swiss Brutalist/High-Contrast dark theme.
Setup Phosphor Icons via: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk or a similar strong Grotesque. Use IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn rounded corners (e.g. rounded-lg, rounded-xl). Override everything to rounded-none or rounded-sm.
The layout must expose the grid. Use 1px borders (border-border) aggressively between sections to create a 'cockpit' feel.
Avoid any gradients in backgrounds. Rely on solid colors (#050505, #0F0F0F) and sharp borders.
Use Recharts for the Analytics Engine, Executive Dashboard, and Budget Optimizer. Style charts to be monochrome with one accent color.
Always explicitly set text colors on hover/active states.
For the left sidebar, use a persistent collapsible layout.
Make sure to implement the required modules (Marketing Strategy Generator, Content Studio, Lead Management, Analytics, etc.) as distinct views or massive bento grid segments.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or dense analytical grid layouts.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Phosphor Icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, explicit color shifts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable between major layout sections, but keep internal dashboard components dense.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Override Shadcn default roundedness and shadow to match the sharp aesthetic.
Use Shadcn calendar for date pickers, Shadcn dropdown-menu for selects.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns.
